panel.title: Task progress
panel.description: Start a run and watch the pill at the bottom of the map, then open its log. Each run reports progress a different way.

section.title: Runs
section.description: Steps: named phases, each one written to the log. Fraction: set_progress(value) fills the ring and writes nothing. Download: set_progress(value, detail=...) alternates the title with the current tile, and the log keeps only the per-layer steps. Threads: the same download from a worker thread; start the shared pool run in two tabs, and each pill shows only its own run.
